# id: # 英文界面用的标题与修复建议。中文原文在 checklist.tsv，检索仍然用那份。
# 加条目时两边都要加：缺一条，英文界面就会退回中文。

title: Endpoint has no auth middleware; anonymous access works
fix: Enforce at the gateway, declare an explicit allowlist

title: Hardcoded backdoor account or universal password
fix: Remove the backdoor, store credentials hashed

title: Default credentials not forced to change (admin/admin)
fix: Force a change on first login, disable the default account

title: Passwords stored in plaintext
fix: Move to Argon2id/bcrypt and migrate existing rows

title: Weak unsalted hash (MD5/SHA1)
fix: Argon2id with a per-user random salt

title: No password strength or length check
fix: Validate length and a breached-password list server-side

title: No lockout or backoff after failed logins
fix: Count, lock, delay, and add a captcha

title: Usernames or phone numbers can be enumerated
fix: One message for every case, constant response time

title: Verification codes can be tried unlimited times
fix: Single use, attempt limit, bound to the session

title: Verification codes never expire and can be replayed
Verification code echoed back in the response
fix: Keep it server-side, never return it

title: Password reset token is predictable or never expires
fix: High-entropy random, short TTL, single use

title: Password reset does not check the old password
fix: Require the old password or a second factor

title: Signup has no rate limit or captcha
OAuth state is not validated
fix: Bind state to the session and check it

title: OAuth lacks PKCE or uses the implicit flow
Third-party account linking does not verify ownership
fix: Verify the logged-in identity before linking

title: Remember me token never expires
fix: Give it a TTL and rotate it

title: MFA can be skipped by calling the next endpoint directly
Trusted devices never expire
fix: Expire them periodically, allow remote revoke

title: Logout only clears the frontend, the server session lives on
Authentication enforced in a frontend route guard
IDOR: changing an id reads someone else's record
fix: Every query carries an owner condition

title: Vertical privilege escalation: a normal user calls admin endpoints
Batch endpoint does not authorise each item
fix: Check every item, reject the batch on any failure

title: Authorisation trusts a role sent by the client
fix: Read the role from the server session only

title: No permission matrix, role checks scattered everywhere
File download allows direct object reference
Export and report endpoints skip authorisation
Admin console shares weak authentication
fix: Separate strong auth plus an IP allowlist

title: Share links never expire and can be enumerated
Permission changes do not take effect (cache)
An old API version bypasses the new authorisation
fix: Retire old versions, one entry point

title: List endpoint checks permission, the detail endpoint does not
fix: Guard every entry point the same way

title: Update endpoint does not check the owner
fix: The UPDATE carries an owner condition

title: A feature flag used as an authorisation check
fix: A flag is not authorisation; check server-side

title: JWT secret is weak or hardcoded
fix: Strong random key held in a key management service

title: Permissions embedded in a long-lived JWT
fix: Short TTL plus a server-side recheck

title: Token stored in localStorage
fix: Move it to an HttpOnly cookie

title: Token appears in URLs, logs or the Referer
fix: Pass it in a header only

title: Refresh token not rotated or never expires
Logout does not revoke the server session
fix: Server-side denylist or a session version

title: Session fixation
fix: Rebuild the session on successful login

title: Unlimited concurrent sessions
fix: Cap the count, drop the oldest

title: Old sessions survive a password change
fix: Bump a session version to invalidate them all

title: CSRF token reusable or never checked
fix: Single use per request, verified server-side

title: Double-submit cookie implemented incorrectly
fix: Compare properly and sign the cookie

title: Dynamic ORDER BY or column-name injection
NoSQL operator injection
fix: Strict type checks plus an operator allowlist

title: Command injection (exec / spawn concatenation)
fix: Pass an argument array, no shell parsing

title: SSTI template injection
fix: Sandbox the template, never render user strings

title: SVG/HTML upload leads to XSS
fix: Force a download header or a separate domain

title: HTTP response header injection
fix: Strip CRLF, never let users set headers

title: CSV/Excel formula injection
fix: Prefix the value with a quote

title: ReDoS
fix: Cap the length, rewrite without backtracking

title: Validation only in the frontend
fix: The server is the only trusted validator

title: Type confusion (a string treated as a number)
Unbounded input length
fix: Cap the length and the body size

title: HTTP parameter pollution (HPP)
fix: Take one value and normalise it

title: Extra fields write into sensitive columns
Case or whitespace bypasses a denylist
JSON nested deeply enough to DoS
Wildcard abuse forces a full table scan
fix: Require at least one real condition

title: Mixed encodings (UTF-8 / GBK)
fix: Standardise on UTF-8, reject invalid bytes

title: Frontend and backend validation disagree
fix: One source of truth: the backend

title: MIME type and file header unchecked
fix: Read the header to learn the real type

title: Stored inside the web root
fix: Object storage or a non-executable directory

title: A same-name upload overwrites the old one
ZIP bomb
fix: Cap the expansion ratio and the total

title: No malware scan
fix: Hook up an antivirus or a sandbox

title: Temp files never cleaned up
fix: Scheduled cleanup plus a lifecycle policy

title: Direct-to-bucket upload with the wrong permissions
Presigned URL too permissive or too long-lived
SSRF bypasses (decimal IP, short hostnames, DNS rebinding)
fix: Resolve first, then check the real IP

title: Open redirect
fix: Relative paths or an allowlisted domain only

title: Host header injection (reset-link poisoning)
fix: Configure a fixed domain, never trust Host

title: Certificate verification disabled
fix: Restore it and configure the CA correctly

title: Weak TLS version or cipher suite
WebSocket without auth or an Origin check
fix: Authenticate at the handshake, verify Origin

title: No message rate limit on WebSocket
X-Forwarded-For trusted unconditionally
fix: Trust only the known proxy chain

title: Cache poisoning
fix: Normalise the cache key, filter headers

title: No rate limiting anywhere
fix: A global limit at the gateway

title: Login endpoint unlimited, credential stuffing
fix: Limit by account and by IP

title: Unlimited SMS or email sends, bombing and cost abuse
fix: Limit by phone, IP and device

title: Unlimited signup or invites, promo abuse
fix: Rate limit, risk control, device fingerprint

title: IP-only rate limiting, bypassed by a proxy pool
IP-only, so one account can hammer
Rate-limit thresholds wrong (too tight or too loose)
Rate limiting implemented in the frontend
fix: Enforce on the server or the gateway

title: Per-instance counters make the limit useless
Sensitive actions without a second factor
No request body size limit
fix: Cap at 1 MB and reject early

title: No concurrency limit, the pool exhausts
Batch endpoint without an item cap
Unbounded pagination, deep pages collapse
fix: Cursor pagination plus a maximum page

title: Error responses leak stack traces, SQL or paths
Error codes inconsistent, clients parse the message
Success responses carry extra fields (hash, token, internal id)
No API versioning, old versions never retired
GraphQL without depth or complexity limits
GraphQL batching bypasses the rate limit
REST methods misused (GET with side effects)
Parameter pollution bypasses authorisation
fix: Parse once and authorise the same value

title: No request id, failures are untraceable
Public API without signatures or replay protection
Public API without quota or tenant isolation
Streaming download without a speed limit
Health check leaks dependencies and versions
Short links or share codes enumerable
Callback or redirect URL unchecked (open redirect)
Fixed or predictable IV
fix: A random IV sent with the ciphertext

title: Key stored next to the ciphertext
No key rotation
fix: Version the keys and rotate on a schedule

title: No salt, or a fixed salt
Timestamp and nonce unchecked, replay possible
fix: Time window plus a nonce cache

title: Encryption without authentication (no MAC or AEAD)
Padding oracle
fix: One error response for every failure

title: Test keys reach production
fix: Environment isolation plus a startup check

title: IV stored in plaintext next to the key
Hardcoded secret in source
fix: Move it to a secret manager

title: Frontend bundle contains a secret
fix: Proxy the call through the backend

title: service_role or a private key shipped to the client
fix: Anonymous key only, with RLS on

title: Secret leaked in git history (file already deleted)
fix: Rotate the secret and scrub the history

title: Logs or crash reports contain secrets
CI variables visible to fork PRs
Full stack traces shown to users
Default admin path reachable
fix: Change the path and add strong auth

title: Database exposed to the internet
fix: Private network plus an IP allowlist

title: Database with a weak or missing password
Object storage publicly readable or writable
Privileged container, or docker.sock mounted
fix: Remove the privilege and the mount

title: Source maps shipped
fix: Off in production, or uploaded privately

title: Environment variables can override critical config
fix: Validate the config schema at startup

title: Config has no schema, a bad value takes effect silently
fix: Validate at startup and fail fast

title: Price or amount comes from the client
fix: Price on the server, the client only displays

title: Duplicate orders
fix: Idempotency key plus a unique constraint

title: Payment amount differs from the order amount
Payment callback without signature verification
fix: Verify the signature, the amount and the order

title: Order state machine can skip states
Concurrent balance or points decrement
fix: Row lock or an atomic update

title: Trial and free quota can be reset
fix: Bind to identity, device or payment

title: Coupons enumerable
fix: High-entropy codes plus a claim limit

title: Flash sale without queueing or warm-up
Purchase limit enforced only in the frontend
Someone else's order can be cancelled
Export without row or permission limits
Delete without soft delete or a recycle bin
fix: Soft delete plus a retention window

title: Counter fields writable by the client (likes, sales)
fix: Computed server-side, never written by clients

title: Time window not validated (expired still works)
Region or compliance restrictions not enforced
fix: Enforce server-side, use IP as a hint

title: Free trial charges automatically once a card is entered
fix: State it plainly, add a confirm step

title: Frontend and backend compute discounts in a different order
No privacy policy or consent record
Logs contain PII, passwords or tokens
Crash reports include the full request body
No right-to-erasure implementation
fix: Cascading delete plus an async job

title: No data export for the user
Third-party SDK sends user data back
No data retention period
fix: Archive and delete on a schedule

title: Cache or queue retains sensitive data
Sensitive data in localStorage
fix: Move it out, or encrypt it

title: Sensitive logic in the frontend (pricing, risk, permissions)
Frontend contains internal addresses or secrets
fix: Proxy via the backend, ship no credentials

title: Frontend routing without permission checks
fix: Check server-side; the frontend is UX only

title: No error boundary, the page goes blank
fix: An ErrorBoundary plus a fallback UI

title: Stale cache breaks after an update
fix: Version the assets, force a refresh

title: Sensitive information not masked in the UI
Deprecated package pulled in
fix: Replace it with a maintained alternative

title: Malicious postinstall script
fix: Install without scripts, in a sandbox

title: No lockfile
fix: Commit the lockfile, verify it in CI

title: Dependency count ballooning
fix: Trim; write it yourself when you can

title: Known CVEs not scanned
fix: Wire SCA into CI and block on it

title: Build script curls a remote script and runs it
fix: Pin the version, verify the hash

title: Private registry unauthenticated, or falls back to public
fix: Force the private registry with auth

title: Package signature or hash not verified
Generated code copies a copyrighted snippet
fix: Rewrite it, run a licence review

title: Admin ports exposed to the internet
Object storage ACL wrong
fix: Private bucket plus a bucket policy

title: Snapshots or images shared publicly
fix: Make them private, audit the shares

title: No backups, or backups that cannot be restored
fix: Rehearse restores, keep an offsite copy

title: Metadata service not hardened (IMDSv1)
fix: Force IMDSv2 plus a hop limit

title: Unlimited retries cause a storm
fix: Retry cap plus a circuit breaker

title: Connection pool unbounded
fix: Pool cap plus a wait timeout

title: Large files read into memory whole
No backpressure, the queue grows forever
fix: Bounded queue plus a rejection policy

title: Deadlock, or locks held too broadly
Cache stampede
fix: Cache the empty result, randomise the TTL

title: Cache and database disagree
fix: Write the DB, drop the cache, delete again after a delay

title: Blocking calls to external services
fix: Go async, or use a queue

title: No graceful shutdown
fix: Drain traffic, let the work finish

title: No health check or readiness probe
No audit log
fix: Record who, what, when, before and after

title: Users can inject fake log lines
No request tracing id
fix: A traceId through the whole chain

title: No anomaly monitoring on request rate
No canary release or feature flag
No rotation process after a key leak
Direct prompt injection (repo, docs, web page)
fix: Isolate untrusted content; separate instructions from data

title: Indirect prompt injection (tool output)
fix: Treat tool output as data, never as instructions

title: Tool permissions too broad (shell, DB, cloud)
Credentials can be read and exfiltrated
Auto-commit or auto-deploy without a gate
Infinite loop or no budget cap
fix: Step limit plus a budget breaker

title: Generated code contains a hidden backdoor
fix: Mandatory review; write critical paths yourself

title: Training-data feedback leaks internal code
fix: Enterprise tier, opt out of training

title: Model output executed directly (eval / SQL)
fix: Allowlist plus parameterisation; never execute it directly

title: RAG knowledge base retrieved across permissions
Hallucinated APIs or methods that do not exist
fix: Type checking plus tests as a backstop

title: Concurrency race
fix: Lock, or use an atomic operation

title: No tests, or only the happy path
fix: Cover the edges and the failures

title: Tests share the implementation's blind spot
fix: Write the critical cases by hand

title: Layering broken
fix: Layer constraints plus a lint rule

title: Environments differ (works locally, dies in prod)
